name: Парирование
subject: A burgundy kite shield with silver rim and restrained brass central boss is firmly held from behind by a gauntlet entering at bottom left. An enemy straight silver blade strikes the shield's UPPER RIGHT metal rim; short white/gold contact sparks ONLY at the contact point and enemy blade visibly deflected to right. No return attack, no sustained magical dome, no explosion. Dark navy.
caption: Один удар перехвачен щитом; искры расположены в точке контакта.
